item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-21 23:59
Institution: Univ. PERUGIA, Perugia
Field: Classics, philology, literature, art history / 10/STAN-01 Storia greca e romana

The position requires research activity in the field of Greek history across its full chronological span. Research must be grounded in appropriate tools and methods of historical enquiry, with particular emphasis on the analysis of literary and epigraphic sources. It will focus on the history of political ideas, systems, and institutions of the Greek city-states, paying attention also to discursive practices and drawing on interdisciplinary perspectives. The research will encompass the political culture of Sparta and its development through to the Hellenistic period, as well as the experience of the democratic polis throughout the Greek world, from its establishment in the Classical period…

item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-21 23:59
Institution: Univ. PERUGIA, Perugia
Field: Classics, philology, literature, art history / 10/ARCH-01 Archeologia

The project investigates Roman painting as a complex and historically dynamic system of meaning production, through the analysis of the formal and iconographic processes underlying the construction of images. The research will examine figurative syntax and iconographic variations as interdependent aspects of a single process of generating form and constructing meaning, focusing on relationships among figures, gestures and gazes, spatial organization, and the composition of mythological, epic and historical scenes. item.description:

Institution: Univ. TORINO, Turin
Field: Classics, philology, literature, art history / 10/PEMM-01 Arti performative, musicali, cinematografiche e mediali

The rise of generative AI brought renewed emphasis to the problem of deception in synthetic media, such as computer-generated images, texts, music, and videos, and to the potential misuses of the persuasive abilities of chatbots. Surprisingly little efforts, however, have so far been made to develop appropriate conceptual tools to situate and further interrogate the role of deception in AI. This project proposes an exploration of the conceptions of the water cycle and the environment preserved in Arabic sources composed from the twelfth century onwards, during the period commonly defined as post-classical. Although hydraulic engineering in the Arab-Islamic context has been the subject of numerous studies, a history of hydrological thought remains to be written for the centuries following the twelfth. Here, hydrological thought is understood both as systemic reflection on water within the global environment (hydrological cycle, water balance) and as the study of specific phenomena related to it, such as precipitation and its relationship with orography, groundwater and karst…

item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Design, methodological supervision, for Italian Sign Language assessment and certification. (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-05 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Roma
Field: Classics, philology, literature, art history / 10/GLOT-01 Glottologia e linguistica

The research concerns the design, methodological coordination, and psychometric and statistical validation of tools for the assessment and certification of proficiency in Italian Sign Language (LIS). The activities will include defining the validation design, overseeing data collection and quality-control procedures, and applying psychometric methods and advanced statistical models to analyse reliability, validity, internal consistency, and item quality. They will also include the development of standardised protocols, technical and scientific reports, and operational recommendations to ensure fairness, accuracy, and comparability in the measurement of language proficiency.
